senses.gloss: to char, burn bread so as to make it uneatable; to prepare a wick by charring.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 21b:2">Pes. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>חֵירְכוֹ קודם וכ׳</he> he charred the leavened bread before the time appointed for the removal of leavened matter. Y. Sabb. II, 5ᵃ top <he>מְחָרְכִין</he> (<cite ref="L00487"><he>לין</he></cite>) <he>לן</he> they char them (the wicks).—Part. pass. <he>מְחוֹרָךְ</he>, fem. <he>מְחוֹרֶכֶת</he>, pl. <he>מְחוֹרָכִין</he>, <he>מְחוֹרָכוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 2:1">Tosef. Sabb. II, 1</cite> (v. Var. ed. Zuck.); <cite ref="Shabbat 29a">Sabb. 29ᵃ</cite> (v. Tosaf. a. l.).

senses.gloss: to be singed, burnt. Tanḥ. Noah 13 נ׳ שער וכ׳ the hair of his head and beard was singed.
units: <cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 33">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXIII</cite> <he>נִתְחָרְכוּ וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>) his hair was singed. Y. Sabb. XVI, 15ᶜ <he>הדורשה מִתְחָרֵךְ</he> he who preaches it (the Agadah) will burn himself (at the fire of the Law); (<cite ref="Tractate Soferim 16:2">Treat. Sof’rim XVI, 2</cite> <he>מתברך</he>, corr. acc.)
